yt_title: Before you unsave Instagram saved posts, do this first
caption:
Unsaving it all? Download first.

Before you clear your Instagram saved reels, get a copy: once you unsave a post, it's gone from your Saved list.

1. Download your Instagram data, tick only Saved.
2. Drop the zip into SaveSort: every save sorted by topic, in your browser, nothing uploaded.
3. Keep the Do it ones. Then unsave the rest.

In our sample report, 30 of 156 saves were Do it.

Find your keepers first. Free, link in bio.

Sorty's voice is AI. Our sample report (156 saves) is real.
